packing_uniformity.metric: kappa=max_cell_edge/min_cell_edge on the exact literal carrier family

coordination.metric: average all-pairs graph distance on the module adjacency graph

cyclic_transport.metric: existence of a single shell-symmetry generator acting transitively as one cycle over every module and closing after module_count steps

receipt_redundancy.model: edge receipt is valid iff it lies in the GF(2) cut space; cycle-space checks are parity checks
receipt_redundancy.metric: minimum nonzero undetected edge-error weight = graph edge connectivity lambda
receipt_redundancy.derived_detection_scope: detect every edge-bit error of weight < lambda

governance: structural winners are function-specific and do not imply overall architecture superiority
receipt test is a graph-bit model, not a quantum logical-error result
packing metric is geometric, not an energy or hardware-noise model
